title: Rep. Mike Levin discusses priorities including homelessness and cost reduction
text:
Rep. Mike Levin California's 49th Congressional District | Facebook Website
Rep. Mike Levin California's 49th Congressional District | Facebook Website
Rep. Mike Levin, representing California's 49th district in the U.S. Congress since 2019, has been active on social media discussing various issues he is addressing in Washington. His recent tweets cover topics ranging from administrative actions to local community initiatives.
On February 19, 2025, Rep. Levin shared insights from his discussion with the OC Register regarding multiple subjects he is involved with in Washington. He mentioned, "From the Trump Admin’s recent actions to discussing Elon Musk, the Appropriations Committee, and the spent fuel at San Onofre, I sat down with the OC Register to talk about what I’ve been working on in Washington."
Continuing his focus on local issues, on February 20, 2025, Rep. Levin highlighted his efforts to combat homelessness in his community. He stated that one of his top priorities is fighting this crisis and expressed satisfaction at securing federal funding for a new shelter: "One of my top priorities in Congress has been working to fight the homelessness crisis in our community. I’m glad I was able to secure $2.25 million in federal funding to help open Oceanside’s first year-round homeless shelter, and I’ll keep fighting for the resources we need.…"
Later that day, Rep. Levin questioned efforts related to cost reduction policies by asking rhetorically on social media: "What happened to bringing costs down on day one?"
